about: Plain names for the guided setup (tools/build_config.py new). Presentation only: which switches exist, their ranges and their dependency rules stay in System_BuildConfig.h, which the setup evaluates for the chosen board. 'needs' and 'sdk' are shortcuts the setup applies and then checks against that header. The host test build_config_catalog fails when a switch or a board is missing here.

p4x_eye.title: Espressif ESP32-P4X-EYE
p4x_eye.hardware: camera, microphone, display, wheel and buttons, microSD slot, 32 MB PSRAM; Wi-Fi and Bluetooth through its ESP32-C6

waveshare_p4_touch_lcd_5.title: Waveshare ESP32-P4 Touch LCD 5
waveshare_p4_touch_lcd_5.hardware: 5-inch touch display, microphone, speaker, microSD slot, camera connector; Wi-Fi and Bluetooth through its ESP32-C6

xiao_s3.title: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 (Sense)
xiao_s3.hardware: camera, microphone and microSD on the Sense expansion board; 8 MB PSRAM, 8 MB flash

feathers3.title: Unexpected Maker FeatherS3
feathers3.hardware: STEMMA QT port for I2C sensors and displays, battery connector; 16 MB flash

feathers3_fe.title: Unexpected Maker FeatherS3, flash-encrypted
feathers3_fe.caution: The first boot of this build on a board that was never encrypted burns eFuses and encrypts its flash for good. Never flash it to a board you do not mean to encrypt (boards/feathers3_fe.defaults).
